Power-Up

This Transformation can be learned by anyone as a Rank 2 Technique. You grow an additional set of arms out of your back, granting you benefits in combat.

  • All Techniques that you cast begin as if they were cast for 1 round, if possible.

  • You attack with an additional Combo Attack Roll as part of a Technique that does multiple Combo Attack Rolls.

  • You may make an additional attack as part of the Attack Action or Ki Blast Action

  • You may hold a Light Weapon in each additional hand, allowing you to use them as an alternative Off-Hand Weapon. Your Dexterity Modifier is halved with these Weapons.

  • 2 Stamina Upkeep
